description: Explore-to-issue structured handoff with YAML frontmatter carrying workflow recommendation and risk

tasks.title: Add risk field to Issue model across server and web types
tasks.description: Introduce a nullable `risk` field on the Issue model. Extend the server DTO (CreateIssueRequest), Issue grain (persist in CreateAsync), IssueInfo and IssueReadModel (return in queries), and DB schema (nullable column migration). Update the web TypeScript Issue interface and the createIssue API client to accept and return risk.
acceptanceCriteria: CreateIssueRequest.Risk is accepted and persisted by IssueGrain.CreateAsync
GET /api/issues returns risk in issue responses for both list and detail
DB migration adds nullable risk column; existing issues have NULL risk
TypeScript Issue interface includes risk?: string | null and createIssue() sends it
Server tests: issue created with risk='high' stores and returns it; issue created without risk returns null
Web API client tests: createIssue with risk includes it in request payload
tasks.output: Risk field end-to-end: server DTO → DB persistence → query response → web type
tasks.notes: Design D3. The field is nullable (default NULL). Server-side validation constrains to low/medium/high. The Issue interface in types.ts already has many nullable fields; risk follows the same pattern.

tasks.title: CLI frontmatter parsing for mo issue create --body-file
tasks.description: Add frontmatter parsing to the CLI issue create flow. Implement FrontmatterParser that extracts YAML frontmatter (recommended_workflow, recommended_workflow_reason, risk) from body files. Integrate into the create handler: after BodyInputResolver.ResolveAsync returns the body text, parse frontmatter and use extracted values as defaults for --workflow-profile and --risk, with explicit CLI flags taking precedence. Add --risk flag. Emit warning when no frontmatter found or YAML is malformed.
acceptanceCriteria: Body file with frontmatter auto-fills workflowProfileId and risk in create request
Explicit --workflow-profile flag overrides frontmatter recommended_workflow
Missing frontmatter emits warning but creation succeeds
Malformed YAML frontmatter emits warning but body still sent
Unrecognized frontmatter fields are silently ignored
Body file without frontmatter (no leading ---) treated as plain body
New --risk CLI flag accepted and sent in create request
Unit tests: FrontmatterParser handles valid, missing, malformed, and partial frontmatter
Integration tests: mo issue create --body-file with frontmatter-filled body.md
tasks.output: FrontmatterParser.cs, updated BodyInputResolver or BuildCreate flow, --risk option, unit and integration tests
tasks.notes: Design D1-D2. Simple line-scanning parser: find first --- delimited block, split on first : per line. Multi-line recommended_workflow_reason supported via indented continuation. No YAML library dependency.

tasks.title: mo workflow list --described server endpoint and CLI option
tasks.description: Add a --described option to `mo workflow list` that emits each workflow profile's id, displayName, description, and suitableFor metadata. Build a server endpoint (GET /api/workflow-profiles) that reads from IssueWorkflowProfileRegistry and returns the enriched profile list. Wire the CLI option to call the new endpoint and format the described output.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/workflow-profiles returns JSON array with id, displayName, description, suitableFor per profile
mo workflow list --described emits human-readable profile descriptions with suitable_for context
mo workflow list (without --described) preserves existing behavior
Server endpoint tests: response schema matches expected fields
CLI tests: --described flag routes to correct endpoint and formats output
tasks.output: Server endpoint GET /api/workflow-profiles, CLI --described flag on workflow list
tasks.notes: Design D5. suitableFor metadata is a prerequisite — if absent, endpoint returns empty arrays. The CLI command infrastructure works regardless; matching quality improves when suitable_for is populated. The IssueWorkflowProfileRegistry already tracks all profiles; the endpoint composes from registry entries.

tasks.title: Web UI create-issue dialog frontmatter detection and risk display
tasks.description: Add client-side frontmatter parsing to the CreateIssueDialog. When body text starts with ---, extract the YAML frontmatter block and surface recommended_workflow and recommended_workflow_reason above the workflow selector. Pre-fill the workflow selector with the recommendation. Add a risk selector (low/medium/high) that is pre-filled from frontmatter when present. Support one-click acceptance of the recommendation by submitting with pre-filled values.

Workflow selector is pre-filled with recommended_workflow from frontmatter

createIssue() API client accepts and sends workflowProfileId in the request body
Component tests: frontmatter detection, recommendation display, override behavior
tasks.output: Updated CreateIssueDialog.tsx with frontmatter-aware recommendation panel and risk selector
tasks.notes: Design D4. Frontmatter is parsed client-side with a useMemo hook watching the body textarea. The Issue TS type already has workflowProfileId; we send it in createIssue(). Risk selector uses existing PRIORITIES pattern.

tasks.title: Update mohist-explore skill packaged guidance for structured issue body production
tasks.description: Update the packaged skill content at packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/skill-data/mohist-explore/SKILL.md to include: (1) instructions for producing frontmatter-annotated issue body files with recommended_workflow, recommended_workflow_reason, and risk; (2) invocation of `mo workflow list --described` to discover available workflows before recommending; (3) template for the structured body sections (Background, Goal, Non-goals, Acceptance criteria); (4) user confirmation flow before running `mo issue create --body-file`.
